plannerAuthority.scope: Decompose, gate, and verify the synthetic fixture mission only.
plannerAuthority.separation: The planner does not implement worker deliverables; workers may change only the paths and satisfy only the objectives authorized by their plan capsules.

goalDecisions.resolution: Normalize an iterable of raw mission records into a new, deterministic array in input order. Each output record has exactly id, title, owner, state, priority, and staleMinutes; string fields are trimmed, state and priority are lowercase, staleMinutes is a finite non-negative number, and malformed records fail with a clear error without mutating the input.

Provide a pure filter over normalized records with optional owner, state, and priority criteria. Omitted criteria are no-ops, supplied criteria combine with AND semantics, input order is preserved, and no-match queries return an empty array without mutating inputs.

A mission is actionable when state is not done. An actionable mission is stale when staleMinutes is at least 10. Summaries report total, actionable, staleActionable, done, and counts by state from normalized records, without counting completed work as actionable or stale-actionable.

Compose the three verified modules behind a dependency-free Node server bound to loopback. Serve a deterministic browser board using only repository-local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, show filter controls and the agreed health summary, preserve fixture order, and require no network service or external asset.

continuationPolicy.rule: Workers may continue autonomously only while their current capsule remains valid, their changes stay within allowedPaths, and required tests can still be run.
continuationPolicy.onDeviation: Stop the worker and return evidence to PLANNER_DEEP for an explicit re-plan; workers cannot broaden their own scope.

verifierPolicy.independence: Verification authority is separate from planner and worker authority.
requirements: Verify the commit is based on the authorized base or gated dependency work set.
Verify the diff touches only allowedPaths and contains no dependency or network additions.
Run npm test and inspect objective-specific completion evidence.
Record the exact approved commit hash; a passing worker self-report is not verification.

interruptionRecoveryPolicy.rule: After interruption, inspect HEAD, status, diff, existing test output, and verifier receipts before resuming.
interruptionRecoveryPolicy.recovery: Resume only the same capsule from a known committed point; quarantine ambiguous or out-of-scope changes and request planner direction rather than guessing or duplicating work.

workSetGatePolicy.integrationGate: work-item-4-offline-board-integration remains blocked until independent verification records exact passing commit hashes for all three separable work items and the integration work set contains those commits.
workSetGatePolicy.failureRule: A failed or superseded dependency commit closes the integration gate until the replacement commit is independently verified.

releasePolicy.rule: Completion and verification produce candidate commits only.
releasePolicy.stable: Stable does not move automatically; explicit release authority must promote a fully verified integration commit.
releasePolicy.published: Published does not move automatically; explicit release authority must separately approve any publication after Stable.
releasePolicy.remoteActions: This fixture plan authorizes no remote Git action or deployment.
